title: Janakiraman
desc: Two brothers remain sworn to bachelorhood. However, chaos arises when a man tries to get them married to his daughters.

title: Kunguma Chimizh
desc: Orphans Ravi and Philomena meet on a bus journey and fall in love, but poverty and unemployment create a barrier between them.

title: Thaye Bhuvaneshwari
desc: Prema, an ardent devotee of Goddess Soundarya, encounters an evil man, who forces her into submission. However, her belief in the Almighty stands unwavered.

title: Kaveri
desc: Kaveri grows up in an ashram after losing her parents in a religious riot. However, things take a turn when two men from different villages fall in love with her at the same time.

title: Dharma
desc: Intolerant of injustice, Dharma is arrested for killing a man for molesting his sister. Upon his release, he becomes a powerful gangster to fight off evil in society.
